recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, brightly lit photograph of four men in matching tan shirts singing, framed by a clean white background and a structured footer containing horizontal stripes and condensed serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Staggered depth of field between the four subjects
Contrast between the warm tan shirts and the cool white/blue background elements
Alignment of the primary title across the top margin
Horizontal banding in the lower third creating a distinct information zone
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with minimal shadows on the background
Matching tan button-down shirts with dark turtlenecks underneath
Red and blue horizontal stripes separating the image from the tracklist

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four male figures arranged in a diamond formation; the central figure is largest and slightly forward, others are scaled down to create depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The open-mouthed, singing expression of the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top title, moves down through the faces of the singers, and settles on the structured text block at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top and bottom margins to allow for heavy typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background and tan/khaki clothing providing a warm, neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for primary text and shadows in the clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red and medium blue used for secondary title text and horizontal divider stripes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) throughout with saturated primary accents in the graphic elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed grotesque sans-serif and high-contrast modern serif.
letterConstructionRules: Top title uses ultra-condensed, heavy-weight sans-serif with flat terminals.
Bottom text uses a high-contrast, condensed serif with vertical stress and thin hairlines.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation point in the title matches the cap height and weight of the letters.
Forward slashes in the tracklist act as rhythmic dividers.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold condensed sans-serif for impact paired with elegant, spaced-out serif for detail.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the top title.
Matches the high-contrast, vertical elegance of the tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio photograph of four men in tan button-down shirts and black turtlenecks, singing with joyful expressions. The background is pure white. The men are arranged in a staggered group. Leave a wide white margin at the top and a large white block at the bottom separated by a red and blue horizontal stripe.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, ultra-condensed sans-serif title in black and red at the top. In the bottom white section, add a multi-line tracklist using a condensed, high-contrast serif font in all caps, with wide tracking and forward slashes between items.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-key with minimal background shadows?
Are the red and blue stripes perfectly horizontal?
Is the bottom text set in a high-contrast serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific tan hue of the shirts
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent shirt color across all subjects
Ensure the red and blue stripes do not bleed into the text
Verify the 'singing' mouth shapes look natural and not distorted
Confirm the white space at the top is sufficient for the title
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-key group portraiture with a structured footer containing primary-colored stripes and high-contrast condensed serif typography.
